# Praktikum *Stochastic Frontier Analysis* {#sec-p-sfa} Praktikum ini menyertai bagian SFA pada @sec-puskesmas dan @sec-rumah-sakit. ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} library(Benchmarking) library(frontier) ``` ::: ## Grafik OLS, COLS, dan SFA dengan data contoh Kita menggunakan data `charnes1981` dari *package* Benchmarking. ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} data("charnes1981", package = "Benchmarking") x <- charnes1981$x1 y <- charnes1981$y1 # OLS, lalu garis COLS (OLS digeser ke atas sebesar residual maksimum) ols <- lm(log(y) ~ log(x)) cols_intercept <- coef(ols)[1] + max(residuals(ols)) # Stochastic frontier analysis msfa <- frontier::sfa(log(y) ~ log(x)) ``` ::: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} ggplot() + geom_point(aes(x = log(x), y = log(y))) + geom_abline(intercept = coef(ols)[1], slope = coef(ols)[2]) + geom_abline(intercept = cols_intercept, slope = coef(ols)[2], colour = "red") + geom_abline(intercept = coef(msfa)[1], slope = coef(msfa)[2], colour = "blue") + labs(x = "log(input)", y = "log(output)") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Perbandingan garis OLS (hitam), COLS (merah), dan SFA (biru)](p4-sfa_files/figure-html/fig-p-sfa-dasar-1.png){#fig-p-sfa-dasar fig-align='center' width=85%} ::: ::: ## Fungsi produksi dan fungsi jarak Data `milkProd` (produksi susu peternakan) digunakan untuk membandingkan dua spesifikasi SFA. ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} data("milkProd", package = "Benchmarking") milk <- as_tibble(milkProd) # Spesifikasi fungsi produksi y <- milk |> select(milk) |> as.matrix() x <- milk |> select(vet, energy, cows) |> as.matrix() te_prod <- frontier::sfa(log(y) ~ log(x)) |> efficiencies() # Spesifikasi fungsi jarak (input distance function) Y <- milk |> transmute(inv_cows = 1 / cows) |> as.matrix() X <- milk |> transmute(vet_cows = vet / cows, energy_cows = energy / cows, milk) |> as.matrix() te_dist <- frontier::sfa(log(Y) ~ log(X)) |> efficiencies() summary(c(te_prod)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> Min. 1st Qu. Median Mean 3rd Qu. Max. #> 0.5720 0.8258 0.8855 0.8588 0.9294 0.9786 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} summary(c(te_dist)) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> Min. 1st Qu. Median Mean 3rd Qu. Max. #> 0.5899 0.8506 0.8914 0.8726 0.9306 0.9781 ``` ::: ::: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} ggplot() + geom_point(aes(x = c(te_dist), y = c(te_prod))) + geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, linetype = "dashed") + labs(x = "Efisiensi (fungsi jarak)", y = "Efisiensi (fungsi produksi)") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Skor efisiensi dari fungsi jarak dan fungsi produksi](p4-sfa_files/figure-html/fig-p-sfa-spesifikasi-1.png){#fig-p-sfa-spesifikasi fig-align='center' width=85%} ::: ::: ## Aplikasi pada data rumah sakit ### Estimasi nilai efisiensi ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} hospital <- load_hospital() x <- hospital |> select(gp_FTE, spec_FTE, nurse_total, beds) |> as.matrix() y <- hospital |> select(admissions1) |> as.matrix() sfa_prod <- frontier::sfa(log(y) ~ log(x)) summary(sfa_prod) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> Error Components Frontier (see Battese & Coelli 1992) #> Inefficiency decreases the endogenous variable (as in a production function) #> The dependent variable is logged #> Iterative ML estimation terminated after 12 iterations: #> log likelihood values and parameters of two successive iterations #> are within the tolerance limit #> #> final maximum likelihood estimates #> Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|) #> (Intercept) 4.764768 0.260497 18.2911 < 2.2e-16 *** #> log(x)gp_FTE -0.049272 0.063355 -0.7777 0.4367377 #> log(x)spec_FTE 0.008228 0.027833 0.2956 0.7675203 #> log(x)nurse_total 0.142683 0.043129 3.3083 0.0009386 *** #> log(x)beds 0.835977 0.056249 14.8621 < 2.2e-16 *** #> sigmaSq 0.687873 0.087908 7.8249 5.081e-15 *** #> gamma 0.970952 0.017101 56.7782 < 2.2e-16 *** #> --- #> Signif. codes: 0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1 #> log likelihood value: -130.0349 #> #> cross-sectional data #> total number of observations = 198 #> #> mean efficiency: 0.5919591 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} hospital_sfa <- hospital |> mutate(te_sfa = c(efficiencies(sfa_prod))) var_label(hospital_sfa$te_sfa) <- "Efisiensi Teknis (SFA)" ``` ::: ### Analisis bivariat ::: {#fig-p-sfa-box .cell layout-ncol="2" layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} hospital_sfa |> ggplot() + geom_boxplot(aes(x = non_JavaBali, y = te_sfa)) + labs(x = "Lokasi", y = "Nilai Efisiensi Teknis") hospital_sfa |> ggplot() + geom_boxplot(aes(x = publichospital, y = te_sfa)) + labs(x = "Kepemilikan", y = "Nilai Efisiensi Teknis") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Lokasi](p4-sfa_files/figure-html/fig-p-sfa-box-1.png){#fig-p-sfa-box-1 fig-align='center' width=85%} ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Kepemilikan](p4-sfa_files/figure-html/fig-p-sfa-box-2.png){#fig-p-sfa-box-2 fig-align='center' width=85%} ::: Efisiensi teknis SFA menurut lokasi dan kepemilikan rumah sakit ::: ::: {#tbl-p-sfa-ttest .cell layout-align="center" tbl-cap='Rerata efisiensi teknis SFA menurut lokasi (uji-t)'} ```{.r .cell-code} hospital_sfa |> select(te_sfa, non_JavaBali) |> tbl_summary(by = non_JavaBali, statistic = all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})") |> add_p(all_continuous() ~ "t.test") |> as_flex_table() ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html}

``` ::: ::: ### Analisis multivariabel: SFA satu tahap Dengan *package* frontier, variabel kontekstual dapat dimasukkan langsung ke model inefisiensi (model Battese dan Coelli 1995) setelah tanda `|`. Variabel kontekstual dimasukkan dalam bentuk numerik (0/1). ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} hospital_num <- readr::read_csv("data/hospital.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) sfa_konteks <- frontier::sfa( log(admissions1) ~ log(gp_FTE) + log(spec_FTE) + log(nurse_total) + log(beds) | non_JavaBali + classCD + publichospital, data = hospital_num ) summary(sfa_konteks) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` #> Efficiency Effects Frontier (see Battese & Coelli 1995) #> Inefficiency decreases the endogenous variable (as in a production function) #> The dependent variable is logged #> Iterative ML estimation terminated after 87 iterations: #> log likelihood values and parameters of two successive iterations #> are within the tolerance limit #> #> final maximum likelihood estimates #> Estimate Std. Error z value Pr(>|z|) #> (Intercept) 4.5722e+00 2.6001e-01 17.5847 < 2.2e-16 *** #> log(gp_FTE) -4.4107e-02 5.9239e-02 -0.7446 0.4565 #> log(spec_FTE) -2.3087e-03 2.7216e-02 -0.0848 0.9324 #> log(nurse_total) 1.7250e-01 4.2932e-02 4.0181 5.868e-05 *** #> log(beds) 8.1411e-01 5.6881e-02 14.3125 < 2.2e-16 *** #> Z_(Intercept) -1.2944e+02 3.5334e+02 -0.3663 0.7141 #> Z_non_JavaBali 6.1253e+01 1.7074e+02 0.3587 0.7198 #> Z_classCD -3.8361e+00 1.2625e+01 -0.3038 0.7612 #> Z_publichospital -1.3406e+01 3.6361e+01 -0.3687 0.7123 #> sigmaSq 4.4787e+01 1.2342e+02 0.3629 0.7167 #> gamma 9.9895e-01 2.9743e-03 335.8570 < 2.2e-16 *** #> --- #> Signif. codes: 0 '***' 0.001 '**' 0.01 '*' 0.05 '.' 0.1 ' ' 1 #> log likelihood value: -117.5134 #> #> cross-sectional data #> total number of observations = 198 #> #> mean efficiency: 0.6881371 ``` ::: ::: ## Perbandingan DEA dan SFA Kita menghitung ulang skor DEA (lihat @sec-p-dea) dengan spesifikasi input dan output yang sama dengan model SFA di atas. ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} set.seed(2021) dea_in <- dea.boot(x, y, NREP = 200, RTS = "vrs", ORIENTATION = "in") hospital_sfa <- hospital_sfa |> mutate(te_dea = dea_in$eff.bc) ``` ::: ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} hospital_sfa |> ggplot(aes(x = te_dea, y = te_sfa)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.6) + geom_hline(yintercept = mean(hospital_sfa$te_sfa), linetype = "dashed") + geom_vline(xintercept = mean(hospital_sfa$te_dea), linetype = "dashed") + labs(x = "DEA (terkoreksi bias)", y = "SFA", caption = sprintf("Korelasi Spearman = %.2f", cor(hospital_sfa$te_dea, hospital_sfa$te_sfa, method = "spearman"))) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Perbandingan skor efisiensi DEA dan SFA; garis menunjukkan rerata](p4-sfa_files/figure-html/fig-p-dea-vs-sfa-1.png){#fig-p-dea-vs-sfa fig-align='center' width=85%} ::: :::
